name: UBTECH Robotics Corp Ltd
blurb: UBTECH Robotics Corp Ltd is a Shenzhen-based robotics company engaged in the research, design, development, production, and commercialization of robotic products and services, with operations spanning mainland China, Hong Kong, and international markets. The company is one of China's leading pure-play robotics firms, focused on humanoid and AI-powered robotic platforms. With a market capitalization of approximately HK$56.7 billion, it holds a prominent position in the Hong Kong-listed capital goods sector. Eleven analysts covering the stock forecast earnings to grow at roughly 109% per year, reflecting high expectations for the broader humanoid robotics market.
